description: Checks one thing: whether your self-hosted model server is reachable from outside the machine. Given the diagnostic output your own machine (or AI tool) already produced locally - this tool never reaches your machine or network, it only reasons over what you send it. Resolves to PASS, FAIL, or UNVERIFIABLE (never guessed). On FAIL, returns the complete fix. Nothing you submit is stored, logged, or retained.
name: check_ollama_loopback
